name: Aave V3
rootCause: A misconfigured oracle cap triggered $27.78 million in healthy wstETH liquidations on Aave on March 10. 34 accounts liquidated for a configuration error they had no part in. No attacker, no hack, no market crash. Full reimbursement planned.

descriptions.text: A misconfigured oracle cap triggered $27.78 million in healthy wstETH liquidations on Aave on March 10. 34 accounts liquidated for a configuration error they had no part in. No attacker, no hack, no market crash. Full reimbursement planned.

Aave V3 suffered a CAPO (Capped Asset Price Oracle) misconfiguration by Chaos Labs, which undervalued wstETH by ~2.85%. This triggered wrongful liquidations on 34 healthy positions, resulting in ~$862,000 in losses. Aave DAO fully compensated affected users; no protocol funds were stolen.

Aave V3's wstETH CAPO oracle on Ethereum briefly undervalued wstETH on 2026-03-10, triggering 34 liquidations across Core and Prime and about 10,938 wstETH of liquidation volume. The protocol reported no bad debt and later moved to reimburse affected users. CAPO accepted a snapshotTimestamp that assumed a seven-day-old reference while snapshotRatio was still rate-limited to a smaller onchain increase, so the derived cap fell below the live wstETH rate and triggered liquidations on Ethereum Core and Prime.
